draft.name: 台北 101｜1 cm = 1 px｜俯視建築插畫

brief.intent: Entire Taipei 101 with editable architectural surfaces, facade frames, ornaments, podium and complete spire. No surrounding scene.
brief.viewpoint: Fixed elevated orthographic three-quarter view, azimuth 38°, elevation 25°, world centimeters, 1 pixel per centimeter before projection.
sources: Architect Oneness project description; Evergreen structural design presentation; CTBUH engineering chapter.
assumptions: 508 m height verified. Base width 63.5 m is an architectural literature estimate; individual floor elevations, facade subdivisions, podium outline and ornament dimensions estimated from reference appearance.
Lower taper to z118m; eight 33.6m modules to z386.8m; stepped crown to448m and spire to508m. Not a surveyed engineering model.

children.name: 下段塔身 26 層受光窗格
下段塔身 26 層背光窗格

plan.method: Editable native projected planar vectors and individual surface-grid window components; world units centimeters at scale1, elevated orthographic projection. Estimate undocumented local dimensions while retaining verified total height and characteristic eight outward-flaring tiers.

whole.requirement: Draw entire Taipei 101 from base to spire with its distinctive silhouette.
whole.description: Complete visible building, tapering lower tower, eight projecting bamboo tiers, stepped crown and spire; isolated transparent background without added scenery.

view.requirement: Fixed elevated three-quarter view with visible top surfaces and consistent perspective.
view.description: All visible planes use shared azimuth38 elevation25 orthographic projection; top terraces and roof planes visible.

detail.requirement: Highly detailed realistic architecture including facade structure, window frames and ornamentation; not broad shapes or schematic.
detail.description: Inspect native windows and frames, projecting terraces, visible ornaments, podium/base and crown detail.

materials.description: Glazed turquoise curtain wall, metallic frames, stone podium; consistent bright face and shaded side, recess and ledge shadows.

scale.requirement: Use real-world dimensions at 1 cm = 1 px before perspective, with projected lengths reflecting view.
scale.description: 50800 world unit architectural height, scale1 projection; derived foreshortening, recorded estimates distinguished from verified measurements.

editable.description: All facade panes, frames, ornaments and surfaces are native editable vectors or ovals, not flattened raster.
